items.summary: Research presented at SAINTCON in Provo Utah on Tuesday Oct 27th 2026.Session Name: "AI Agents Gone Rogue? 🤖⚡ Disrupt Agentic Attackers Abusing LLMs via Deception!🚨🪤"Cyber asymmetry has historically favored the attacker, but agentic AI finally gives defenders a chance to flip that equation. While attackers’ autonomous LLMs operate at machine speed, they suffer from a fatal flaw: probabilistic predictability. Rogue agents depend on environmental data to navigate their kill chain, yet their underlying models cannot separate external data from internal instructions within a shared context window. Defenders can leverage this architectural weakness to influence the attacker's reasoning loop. Drawing on telemetry from live, internet-facing confrontations with autonomous threat actors, this session shows defenders how to build relationships with these offensive agents and turn them into defensive assets. Learn how to encourage attacking models to surrender their hidden operational playbooks, nudge rogue AI agents into standing down with false clean bills of health, and bleed adversary budgets dry by routing them into token-burning infinite loops.
